split_methodology.description: Partitions entire scenario groups into train or test. Guarantees 0.0% scenario_id overlap across partitions.

comparison_with_canonical_benchmark.methodology_difference: The canonical benchmark uses fingerprint-grouped holdout, which isolates exact duplicate payloads but allows different loops of the same attack template in both partitions. The scenario-aware benchmark strictly holds out entire attack campaigns (scenario_id), measuring generalization to unobserved scenario instances.
